OK this might be long so bare with me. When I was a kid my dad had one of those GMC custom vans. No less than 5 seconds after I moved we all heard a loud bang and glass breaking. Everyone thought I broke the window since I was just back there. We soon found out that the window had been shot. Apparently a teenage boy was shooting his gun too close to the road, even though he had been told before not to. The window that got shot out was right where I was sitting. I can't remember what all came if it since I was so young. In case anyone is wondering, it was about 1985 or so maybe somewhere in Arkansas. I would have to ask since I have lived in so many places.

I was commuting to work on the highway on a snowy day. The roads were pretty clear. The snow plows had been through and what snow had fallen after quickly melted on the pavement. I was coming around a curve at about 70 mph (speed limit was 65) and moving over to the right lane because I was getting close to my exit when I hit a patch of slush and completely lost control. I kept sliding off the road and somehow i managed to maneuver into a small gap right between a cement barrier and a light pole and into a barbed wire fence.
